description: This file defines a data class `JpegSizeLimiterResult` and an object `JpegSizeLimiter` with a function `compressToLimit` that downsamples and compresses JPEG images to fit within a specified byte size limit.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: A data class representing the result of JPEG compression, including the compressed bytes, dimensions, and quality.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiter
classes.description: An object providing compression logic for resizing and compressing JPEG images to meet byte size constraints.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses an image to fit within a specified maximum byte size by adjusting quality and dimensions, with retry attempts and scaling strategies.
